body:
Changes the first reduction window to drop the initial sample (at `t1`):

- Windows before: `[t1, t2], (t2, t3], ...`
- Windows after: `(t1, t2], (t2, t3], ...`

This solves two problems:

1. If the initial condition contains NaNs (something we saw in the coupler), it no longer corrupts the entire first window.
2. Windows on restarts are exactly the same as the ones you would get from one continuous simulation (assuming they start at an output boundary).

This is a breaking change. We will bump the version to 0.4.0 once other breaking changes are in.
title: Skip initial condition in first reduction window
